newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - KeyCorp cut to accumulate.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - KeyCorp cut to accumulate.

text.p: -- KeyCorp was downgraded to accumulate from buy by Deutsche Morgan Grenfell based on recent price appreciation.
-- Analyst Joel Silverstein said in a research report he also increased earnings estimates by $0.20 a share for both 1997 and 1998.

-- He said the recently announced restructuring program should result in $110 million of cost savings due to a 10 percent cut in its employment base, which should boost the operating ratio to near 55 to 56 percent toward the end of 1997. He also cited a 12 million share repurchase program.
